install_steps: pip install "infinity-emb[all]"  # or: pipx install infinity-emb[all]
note: Python 3.9+. Runs on CPU (optimum/ctranslate2 engines) or GPU (torch engine + CUDA). Docker alternative: docker run -p 7997:7997 michaelf34/infinity:latest v2 --model-id <hf>. All flags also map to INFINITY_* env vars (e.g. INFINITY_MODEL_ID).
